mapper.sql: id, tag_name, tag_code, category, sort, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_tag WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT FROM sys_tag WHERE tag_code = #{tagCode} AND status = 1
SELECT FROM sys_tag WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT t.* FROM sys_tag t INNER JOIN package_tag_rel ptr ON t.id = ptr.tag_id WHERE ptr.package_id = #{packageId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY ptr.id ASC
SELECT t.* FROM sys_tag t INNER JOIN coupon_tag_rel ctr ON t.id = ctr.tag_id WHERE ctr.coupon_id = #{couponId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY ctr.id ASC
SELECT t.* FROM sys_tag t INNER JOIN user_tag_rel utr ON t.id = utr.tag_id WHERE utr.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY utr.id ASC
SELECT t.* FROM sys_tag t INNER JOIN family_tag_rel ftr ON t.id = ftr.tag_id WHERE ftr.family_id = #{familyId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY ftr.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_tag (tag_name, tag_code, category, sort, status) VALUES (#{tagName}, #{tagCode}, #{category}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_tag SET tag_name = #{tagName}, tag_code = #{tagCode}, category = #{category}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE sys_tag SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
